Frequently Asked Questions
Frequently Asked Questions
1. Why should you take management system certification from BIS?
Bureau of Indian Standards( BIS) is National Standards Body of India. BIS issues management system certification licence under BIS ACT 2016.  Bureau of Indian standards have a well qualified and trained pool of auditors. These technically competent people with relevant experience and sector expertise help you improve quality of product/services thereby increasing your market share. The QMS, EMS  & FSMS Certification is accredited from NABCB for various scope of sectors.
2. What is a management system ?
A management system is the way in which an organization manages its business in  order to
3. What is Management system Certification?
It is a third party certification of Management system of an organization to demonstrate its capability to meet the requirements of a management system standard.
4. What are the management system certifications offered by BIS?
BIS offers following 15  types of Management system certifications  offered by BIS
»  o a) IS/ISO 9001 (Quality Management System) Certification
»    b) IS/ISO 14001 (Environmental Management system) Certification
»  c) IS/ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety Management System ) Certification
» d) IS/ISO 22000 ( Food safety Management System) certification
»   e) IS/ISO 50001 ( Energy Management system) Certification

BIS offers two other type of certification i.e. RMC certification & Integrated Milk certification.
5. What is RMC certification  by BIS?
It is a Ready Mix Concrete Certification by BIS as per IS 4629  for Ready Mix Concrete supplying units. This certification assures the  customer quality ready mix concrete as per their requirement at the delivery point of customer.RMC certification is provided as stand alone process certification and also combined with ISO 9001 certification.
6. What is Integrated  Milk certification by BIS?
This is a combination certification of FSMS & product certification of Pasteurised milk pouches ( ISI Mark) . In this certification, Food safety management system of a dairy is assessed from milk collection at the farmer point to delivery to the retail centre. Conformance of pasteurised milk pouch against IS 13668 is also verified. Thus providing the common consumer a complete solution to Quality & food safety of pasteurised milk pouches. The dairies can enhance their brand image and market share with the help of very popular Quality certification Mark of BIS i.e. ISI MARK.
7. What is IMS Certification?
IMS or Integrated Management system certification is a combination of two more management system certification. Most popular IMS certification is for QMS , EMS & OHSMS certifications. In IMS certification single documentation is used and one audit to verify implementation of  two or more different management system standard. This type of certification saves lots of time and money for the organization.
8. How to get Management systems certification from BIS?
You have to apply online (www.manakonline.in) . your application will be scrutinized and  recorded. Stage 1 audit will be organized at  your site on a mutually agreed date. If Stage 1 Audit is satisfactory, stage 2 Audit will be organized on a mutually agreed date by a team of auditors at your site. If audit results are satisfactory, certification will be granted
9. What is ISO 9001 ?
ISO 9001 is the international standard   as for a quality management system (“QMS”).The standard is used by organizations to demonstrate their ability to consistently provide products and services that meet customer and regulatory requirements and to demonstrate continuous improvement.
10. Who can take IS/ ISO 9001 Certification ?
All types of organizations viz large small, micro, product or service providing organization, private or Govt department who wants to demonstrate to its customer and stake holders that it has the capability to meet customer and regulatory requirements consistently.
11. What is IS/ISO 14001 ?
ISO 14001 is the international standard   for  Environmental management system (“EMS”).It helps organizations improve their environmental performance through more efficient use of resources and reduction of waste, gaining a competitive advantage and the trust of stakeholders.
12. Who can take  ISO 14001 Certification ?
Any organization, regardless of size, type and nature, who wants to demonstrate its capabilities to enhance its environmental performance and contribute to Environmental pillar of sustainability through the  environmental aspects of its activities, products and services that the organization determines it can either control or influence considering a life cycle perspective.
13. What is  ISO 45001?
ISO 45001:2018 is the   International Standard,  for Occupational  for an occupational health and safety (OH&S) management system, and gives guidance for its use, to enable organizations to provide safe and healthy workplaces by preventing work-related injury and ill health, as well as by proactively improving its OH&S performance
14. Who can take ISO 45001 Certification?
ISO 45001:2018 can be taken by  any organization that wishes to establish, implement and maintain an OH&S management system to improve occupational health and safety of workers , eliminate hazards and minimize OH&S risks (like accidents, occupational diseases).
15. What is ISO 50001?
This is the  International Standard for Energy Management System. The standard aims to help organizations continually reduce their energy use, and therefore their energy costs and their greenhouse gas emission.  It also helps in continually improving the Energy performance including energy efficiency &  energy security.
16. Who can take ISO 50001 Certification?
Any organization regardless of its type, size, complexity, geographical location, organizational culture or the products and services it provides; can take this certification
17. What is ISO 22000?
This is an International Standard for food safety management. The consequences of unsafe food can be serious. ISO’s food safety management standards help organizations identify and control food safety hazards, and provides a layer of reassurance within the global food supply chain, helping products cross borders and bringing people food that they can trust.
18. Who can take ISO 22000  certification?
Any  organizations in the food chain, regardless of size and complexity that are directly or indirectly involved include, but are not limited to, feed producers, animal food producers, harvesters of wild plants and animals, farmers, producers of ingredients,food manufacturers, retailers, and organizations providing food services, catering services, cleaning and sanitation services, transportation, storage and distribution services, suppliers of equipment, cleaning and disinfectants, packaging materials and other food contact materials, can take ISO 22000 certification.
19. What is ISO 39001?
ISO 39001:2012 is an international standards that specifies requirements for a road traffic safety (RTS) management system to enable an organization that interacts with the road traffic system to reduce death and serious injuries related to road traffic crashes which it can influence.
20. Who can take ISO 39001 certification?
Any organization that interacts with road traffic system like, taxi company, state transport corporations, Goods transporters, Bus companies, schools running school buses, marketing and sales company transporting goods. Supermarkets , road authority etc.
21. What is ISO 21001?
This is an International standards for Educational Organization Management System. It stipulates requirements for the Organization who needs to demonstrate its ability to support the acquisition and development of competence through teaching, learning or research and enhancing the satisfaction of learner, other beneficiaries and   staff.
22. Who can take ISO 21001 Certification?
Any organization that uses a curriculum to support the development of competence through teaching, learning or research, regardless of the type, size or method of delivery can take the certification. Training department of larger organization whose core business is not Education can also take the certification.
23. What is ISO 37001?
It’s the International Standard that allows organizations of all types to prevent, detect and address bribery by adopting an anti-bribery policy, appointing a person to oversee anti-bribery compliance, training, risk assessments and due diligence on projects and business associates, implementing financial and commercial controls, and instituting reporting and investigation procedures.
24. Who can take the ISO 37001 certification?
ISO 37001 certification  can be taken  by any organization, large or small, whether it be in the public, private or voluntary sector, and in any country. It is a flexible tool, which can be adapted according to the size and nature of the organization and the bribery risk it faces.
25. What is ISO 27001?
ISO 27001 is an International Standard for Information Security Management System This standards  enables organizations of any kind to manage the security of assets such as financial information, intellectual property, employee details or information entrusted by third parties.
26. Who can take ISO 27001 Certification?
Any organization regardless of type , size or nature who wants to demonstrate its capability for security of its information assets to the stakeholders.
27. What is ISO 13485?
It is the International Standard which specifies requirements for a quality management system where an organization needs to demonstrate its ability to provide medical  devices and related services that consistently meet customer and applicable regulatory requirements
28. Who can take ISO 13485 certification?
Any organizations that  involved in one or more stages of the life-cycle, including design and development, production, storage and distribution, installation, or servicing of a medical device and design and development or provision of associated activities can take this certification.
29. What IS 23485 ?
It is an Indian standards, formulated by BIS, the national standards Body of India which specifies requirements of ISO 13485 & ISO 16142. This standard enables an organization  to demonstrate its ability to provide medical devices and related services which consistently fulfils the requirements of essential principles of safety and performance along with customer and regulatory requirements.
30. Who can take IS 23485 certification?
Any organizations that  involved in one or more stages of the life-cycle, including design and development, production, storage and distribution, installation, or servicing of a medical device and design and development or provision of associated activities can take this certification
31. What is IS 15000
It is an Indian standards, formulated by BIS, the national standards Body of India on HACCP( Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points).HACCP is a management system in which food safety is addressed through the analysis and control of biological, chemical, and physical hazards from raw material production, procurement and handling, to manufacturing, distribution and consumption of the finished product.
32.  Who can take HACCP certification?
Any  organizations in the food chain, regardless of size and complexity that are directly or indirectly involved include, but are not limited to, feed producers, animal food producers, harvesters of wild plants and animals, farmers, producers of ingredients, food manufacturers, retailers, and organizations providing food services, catering services, cleaning and sanitation services, transportation, storage and distribution services, suppliers of equipment, cleaning and disinfectants, packaging materials and other food contact materials, can take IS 15000 ( HACCP) certification.
33. What is IS 16001 ?
It is an Indian standards on Social accountability, formulated by BIS, the national standards Body of India,  that encourages organizations to develop, maintain, and apply socially & legally  acceptable practices in the workplace.
34. Who can take IS 16001( Social Accountability ) certification?
Any organization  irrespective of type, size, ownership or geographical location, be it Government, private ,  Academic, Charitable Trust or Society, Consumer, Cooperative, NGO and Associations of any other kind, which engages personnel for discharge of its duties on a regular or contractual, paid or honorary basis.
